explanation: Removing your shoes before entering a home is a widely observed sign of respect and cleanliness in the UAE, tied to Emirati hospitality customs and the practice of sitting and dining on floor seating. It is not a universal legal or religious requirement, so the safest approach is simply to follow your host's lead at the door.
local_tip: Watch what your host and other guests do at the entrance, and remove your shoes if you see a shoe rack or pile of shoes.

also_check.note: Shoe removal before entering a home is mandatory and extends to many traditional inns and some restaurants.
Shoe removal is optional and depends entirely on the individual household's preference.
Removing shoes at the door is standard in most homes, and hosts often provide guest slippers.

sources.title: Countries That Always Take Their Shoes Off Inside
